_comment: Hand-labelled ground-truth dependency set for the canonical 10-task seed board (BUILD_SPEC.md §1 / §5.5). Each entry represents a true finish-to-start dependency. Used by scripts/measure_ai.py to compute precision, recall, and acceptance rate.
_note: All 13 canonical edges from BUILD_SPEC.md §1 are the ground truth. The AI pipeline should propose at least the non-obvious ones (not just direct label chains); the measure script reports TP/FP/FN relative to this set.
